intro: Today's headlines highlight a series of major product launches from OpenAI alongside significant shifts in tech policy. From new developer APIs to corporate procurement changes, the industry continues to evolve rapidly. We are also seeing heightened scrutiny from lawmakers and school districts regarding AI integration in infrastructure and education.

must_know.title: Introducing the Agents API
must_know.summary: OpenAI released a new Agents API for cloud orchestration and introduced several developer-focused tools including AgentKit and reinforcement fine-tuning capabilities.
must_know.why_it_matters: New API tooling aims to help developers move AI agent projects from prototypes to production environments more efficiently.

must_know.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Sales
must_know.summary: OpenAI introduced specialized ChatGPT plugins for sales and financial services, alongside a new secure payment feature called ChatGPT Wallet.
must_know.why_it_matters: These vertical-specific tools signal a move toward more integrated business workflow automation within the ChatGPT ecosystem.

must_know.title: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
must_know.summary: Major US school districts are reconsidering their use of Google Search because the company will require AI features to be active on school accounts starting next year.
must_know.why_it_matters: The policy change highlights tensions between educational institutions and Big Tech regarding mandatory AI implementation and data control.

foundation-models.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
foundation-models.summary: OpenAI has made ChatGPT Enterprise available directly through the AWS Marketplace to simplify corporate procurement and billing.
foundation-models.why_it_matters: This partnership makes it easier for large enterprises already using AWS to integrate and pay for OpenAI's commercial AI tools.

foundation-models.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
foundation-models.summary: OpenAI is researching how coding agents are accelerating scientific research and analyzing the performance gaps associated with these systems.
foundation-models.why_it_matters: Understanding how AI agents impact research productivity provides insight into the potential for future self-improving AI systems.

policy.title: Tech lawsuits defined 2026 — and lawmakers want more
policy.summary: US lawmakers are pushing for new regulations before the end of 2026, targeting deepfakes and restrictions on filing lawsuits against online platforms.
policy.why_it_matters: This reflects a legislative push to address AI-driven harms and corporate accountability in the closing months of the year.

policy.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
policy.summary: Satya Nadella stated that much of the world's critical infrastructure remains unpatchable, increasing security risks in the age of AI.
policy.why_it_matters: The comment emphasizes the vulnerability of global infrastructure against potential AI-powered cyberattacks.

big-tech.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
big-tech.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella clarified that recent voluntary buyout offers to 60,000 employees were driven by the strategic shifts required by AI adoption.
big-tech.why_it_matters: This offers insight into how major tech companies are restructuring their workforces in response to the AI transformation.

research.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
research.summary: OpenAI reported progress in AI-assisted chip design, specifically using its models to optimize circuits and RISC-V cores.
research.why_it_matters: The use of foundation models to improve hardware design demonstrates the cross-domain potential of these tools for engineering.

research.title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
research.summary: Startup Osmo is building a foundation model for scent by training on chemical data and human smell sensory evaluations.
research.why_it_matters: This represents a unique application of foundation model architecture to the domain of chemistry and sensory science.

research.title: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
research.summary: Hugging Face released Rumble-2-Flash, a compact 0.5B parameter open-source model designed for speech recognition across 40+ languages.
research.why_it_matters: Efficient, open-source speech models lower the barrier for deploying multilingual voice interfaces in low-resource environments.
